data.title: Health insurance contribution notice from 1 June 2026
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse confirms your voluntary membership from 1 June 2026 and sets contributions at €530.85 per month (health €412.65, care €118.20). Contributions are collected by direct debit.
data.explanation: This is a contribution decision (Beitragsbescheid) for your voluntary health and long-term care insurance. The monthly total is €530.85 and is collected automatically by direct debit on the 15th of the following month, so make sure your account has enough money. If you think the amount is wrong, for example because your income was assessed incorrectly, you may file an objection (Widerspruch). The app shows the deadline. Otherwise no action is needed. Consider getting advice if you are unsure about the income assessment.
data.tax_note: Health and long-term care insurance contributions can generally be deducted as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in your tax return.

items.title: Objection to contribution notice

date.text: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or by recording it in person with Allgemeine Musterkasse.
items.consequence: After the deadline the notice becomes final.
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse, Gesundheitsplatz 5, 30159 Musterstadt, zu erheben.

items.title: Monthly health and care insurance contribution

date.text: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
